newsitem.title: UK: Alba plunges 13.5 pct as H1 profit falls.
newsitem.headline: Alba plunges 13.5 pct as H1 profit falls.

text.p: Shares in television and video firm Alba Plc plunged 13.5 percent on Tuesday after the group reported a fall in pre-tax profits and gave a cautious statement on prospects for the rest of the year.
By 1025 GMT the stock was down 36 pence at 230p.
Alba said first-half pre-tax profits fell to 1.4 million stg from a previous 2.6 million stg due to investment in its distribution network and poor performance and downsizing at Alba France.
"I am confident that the performance of our on-going operations during the second half will compare favourably with the same period last year," said Chairman John Harris in a statement.

"Whether it will be sufficient to make good the effect of the reduced first-half profits caused by non-recurring items, will depend on the level of business during the final quarter of our financial year," he added.
Alba said it had maintained its interim dividend at 1.25 pence per share.
